title: Half of the heating elements were dark.
text: Half of the heating elements were dark.. Toaster looked nice, had good features and decent reviews but out of the box mine had half or more of the heating elements out during intial testing. Tried 5 or 6 times (thinking they would kick in at some point) with the same results. All I can say is I got a bad one and there seems to be poor QC. Amazon was great to deal with (as always...TOP NOTCH!!!) and I am returning it and my toaster search continues-Sigh :(
